Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Astonish
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Astonish
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Astonish' means to surprise or impress someone greatly. 'Surprise' is the most appropriate synonym. 'Calm' and 'Bore' are antonyms, and 'Expect' means to anticipate.
Solution (HI): 'Astonish' का अर्थ है बहुत अधिक आश्चर्यचकित करना। 'Surprise' (आश्चर्य) इसका सबसे उपयुक्त पर्यायवाची है। 'Calm' का अर्थ शांत और 'Bore' का अर्थ ऊबाना होता है।
Short Trick: Think of Astonish = A ton of surprise.

q_en: Which of the following options is closest to the meaning of the word 'gregarious'?
q_hi: Which of the following options is closest to the meaning of the word 'gregarious'?
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Gregarious' refers to a person who is fond of company; sociable. Therefore, 'Sociable' is the closest in meaning.
Solution (HI): 'Gregarious' का अर्थ है मिलनसार या झुंड में रहने वाला व्यक्ति। दिए गए विकल्पों में 'Sociable' (मिलनसार) सबसे सटीक है।
Short Trick: Greg loves groups = Gregarious (sociable).

The (3) ______ increase in vehicular traffic has led to alarming levels of air pollution. (4) ______, local governments must implement strict emission norms, or else the health of millions will be severely (5) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
Solution (EN): The phrase 'engines of economic...' generally takes positive words indicating progress. 'Growth' fits perfectly as cities are universally known as engines of economic growth.
Solution (HI): 'Engines of economic' के साथ प्रगति को दर्शाने वाला शब्द आएगा। शहरों को आर्थिक 'growth' (विकास) का इंजन माना जाता है, इसलिए यह शब्द यहाँ सबसे उपयुक्त है।
Short Trick: Engine = moving forward = growth.

The (3) ______ increase in vehicular traffic has led to alarming levels of air pollution. (4) ______, local governments must implement strict emission norms, or else the health of millions will be severely (5) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
Solution (EN): The phrase 'suffer from' indicates a negative consequence. 'Degradation' (the condition or process of degrading or being degraded) fits perfectly with 'environmental'.
Solution (HI): 'Suffer from' एक नकारात्मक प्रभाव को दर्शाता है। पर्यावरणीय गिरावट के लिए 'degradation' सही शब्द है, जबकि अन्य सभी शब्द सकारात्मक हैं।
Short Trick: Suffer from + Environment = Negative outcome (Degradation).

The rapid expansion of urban areas has brought both opportunities and challenges. While cities are considered engines of economic (1) ______, they also suffer from severe environmental (2) ______. The (3) ______ increase in vehicular traffic has led to alarming levels of air pollution. (4) ______, local governments must implement strict emission norms, or else the health of millions will be severely (5) ______.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Exponential' means becoming more and more rapid. It correctly describes the rapid, alarming increase in traffic that leads to severe pollution. 'Trivial', 'stagnant', and 'rare' are contextually incorrect.
Solution (HI): 'Exponential' का अर्थ है बहुत तेज़ी से बढ़ने वाला। यातायात में भारी वृद्धि (जिससे प्रदूषण बढ़ा) को दर्शाने के लिए यह सबसे उपयुक्त है।
Short Trick: Alarming levels of pollution require a massive/rapid increase (exponential).

(4) ______, local governments must implement strict emission norms, or else the health of millions will be severely (5) ______.

solution:
Solution (EN): 'Therefore' is used as an adverb to introduce the logical consequence or required action stemming from the previously mentioned problem (pollution requiring strict norms).
Solution (HI): 'Therefore' (इसलिए) का उपयोग पिछली समस्या (प्रदूषण) के तार्किक परिणाम या उसके समाधान (सख्त नियम) को पेश करने के लिए किया जाता है।
Short Trick: Identifying a Problem -> 'Therefore' -> Proposing a Solution/Action.

solution:

Short Trick: Severe pollution -> Health is weakened/put at risk (compromised).

q_en:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the paragraph given below.

The scientist presented a facinating theory regarding the origin of the universe. His colleagues, although skeptical at first, eventually acknowledged the brilliant logic behind his hypothesis.
q_hi:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the paragraph given below.

The scientist presented a facinating theory regarding the origin of the universe. His colleagues, although skeptical at first, eventually acknowledged the brilliant logic behind his hypothesis.
solution:
Solution (EN): The incorrectly spelt word is 'facinating'. The correct spelling is 'fascinating', which means extremely interesting or charming.
Solution (HI): 'facinating' की वर्तनी गलत है। सही वर्तनी 'fascinating' (आकर्षक या बहुत दिलचस्प) है। अन्य सभी शब्दों की स्पेलिंग सही है।
Short Trick: Break it down: remember the 'sc' in faSCinating (similar to 'science').
